title: Manufactured Discontent and Fortnite
summary: Dan Olson of Folding Ideas critiques Fortnite's monetization, arguing it uses manufactured discontent, such as shop design and skins, to push spending. The video dissects the psychological techniques behind the game's business model.
why: HN commenters cite it as the definitive critique of Fortnite's monetization and of manipulative free-to-play design.

quote.text: There's a great video[1] that goes into detail on the psychological manipulation used in Fortnite's monetization model.
